NIAlgorithmConvergence.doc: An object that provides the state and reason for user coaching recommendations.

NIConfiguration.doc: An abstract base class for interaction configurations.

NIDLTDOAConfiguration.doc: A configuration that enables Downlink Time-Difference-of-Arrival ranging.

NIDLTDOAMeasurement.doc: Information from a Downlink Time-Difference-of-Arrival anchor that you use to derive a range estimate.

NIDiscoveryToken.doc: An object that uniquely identifies a peer that participates in an interaction session.

NINearbyAccessoryConfiguration.doc: A configuration that enables interaction between iPhone and third-party accessories.

NINearbyObject.doc: Location information for a peer device in an interaction session.

NINearbyPeerConfiguration.doc: A configuration that enables interaction between iPhone or Apple Watch devices.

NISession.doc: An object that identifies a unique connection between two peer devices.

NIDeviceCapability.doc: An interface that adds Boolean values that indicate an interaction session feature support.

NISessionDelegate.doc: An object that monitors and reacts to session updates.

NIAlgorithmConvergenceStatus.doc: The possible states of Camera Assistance.

NIDLTDOACoordinatesType.doc: The possible coordinate types for Downlink Time-Difference-of-Arrival measurement updates.

NIDLTDOACoordinatesTypeGeodetic.doc: A coordinate type that specifies a latitude, longitude, and altitude triplet.

NIDLTDOACoordinatesTypeRelative.doc: A coordinate type that specifies a 3D Cartesian triplet.

init(rawValue:).doc: Initializes a coordinate type for a Downlink Time-Difference-of-Arrival measurement.

NIDLTDOAMeasurementType.doc: The possible phases of downlink positioning signals.

NIDLTDOAMeasurementTypeFinal.doc: A type that indicates the measurement derives from an initial anchor’s last message.

NIDLTDOAMeasurementTypePoll.doc: A type that indicates the measurement derives from an initiating anchor’s first message.

NIDLTDOAMeasurementTypeResponse.doc: A type that indicates the measurement derives from responder anchors’ messages.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a measurement type from the given underlying value.

NIErrorCode.doc: Codes that identify errors in Nearby Interaction.

NINearbyObjectRemovalReason.doc: The reason a session removed a nearby object.

NINearbyObjectVerticalDirectionEstimate.doc: Estimations of a nearby object’s vertical position in relation to the user’s device.

-initWithNetworkIdentifier:.doc: Initializes a Downlink Time-Difference-of-Arrival (DL-TDOA) configuration for a specific tracked area.

-initWithNetworkIdentifier:discoveryMeth.doc: Initializes a DL-TDOA configuration with a network identifier and discovery method.

-initWithAccessoryData:bluetoothPeerIden.doc: Creates a configuration for an accessory with the given Bluetooth peer identifier.

-initWithBluetoothChannelSoundingIdentif.doc: Initializes a configuration for Bluetooth Channel Sounding ranging with an accessory.

-initWithData:error:.doc: Creates a configuration for interaction between iPhone and third-party accessories.

-initWithPeerToken:.doc: Creates a configuration for interaction between devices, including iPhone and Apple Watch.

-pause.doc: Stops sending distance and direction updates to the peer.

-runWithConfiguration:.doc: Starts a session with a nearby peer.

-setARSession:.doc: Provides the framework with an existing AR session to use for Camera Assistance.

-updateMotionState:forObjectWithToken:.doc: Notifies the session of an accessory’s motion state change.

-worldTransformForObject:.doc: Returns a world transform to integrate a nearby object in an AR experience.

reasons.doc: An array of reasons that contribute to the convergence status.

status.doc: The current state of the framework’s Camera Assistance feature.

NIDLTDOADiscoveryMethod.doc: The technologies an app can use to discover Downlink Time-Difference-of-Arrival anchors.

discoveryMethod.doc: The technology your app uses to discover DL-TDOA anchors.

networkIdentifier.doc: A unique identifier for a Downlink Time-Difference-of-Arrival network.

NIDLTDOAMeasurementFloorElevation.doc: An object that describes how high off the ground DL-TDOA anchors reside in the environment.

address.doc: A value that uniquely identifies an anchor in a tracked area.

carrierFrequencyOffset.doc: The drift, as a ratio, across the frequencies of the receiver and the anchor.

clusterInitiatorAddress.doc: The address of the initiator anchor within the same cluster.

coordinates.doc: A triplet that represents the location in 3D space of the anchor that provides the measurement.

coordinatesType.doc: The type of coordinate system that the measurement conforms to.

floorElevation.doc: The floor elevation information for the anchor, if available.

measurementType.doc: The type of anchor message that the measurement derives from.

receiveTime.doc: A timestamp, in seconds, for the time that the device receives the measurement.

responderClockFrequencyOffset.doc: The clock frequency offset of the responder anchor relative to the initiator anchor.

signalStrength.doc: A value that represents the received signal strength, in dBm, from the anchor that provides the measurement.

transmitTime.doc: A transmission timestamp, in seconds, for the received message.

deviceCapabilities.doc: A protocol object that describes the nearby interaction capabilities of a person’s device.

accessoryDiscoveryToken.doc: An identifier for the accessory in a session.

cameraAssistanceEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that combines the spatial awareness of ARKit with Nearby Interaction to improve the accuracy of a nearby object’s position.

NINearbyObjectRemovalReason.doc: The reason a session removed a nearby object.

NINearbyObjectVerticalDirectionEstimate.doc: Estimations of a nearby object’s vertical position in relation to the user’s device.

direction.doc: A vector that points from the user’s device in the direction of the peer device.

discoveryToken.doc: A unique identifier for a peer device in the session.

distance.doc: The distance from the user’s device to the peer device in meters.

horizontalAngle.doc: An angle in radians that indicates the azimuthal direction to the nearby object.

verticalDirectionEstimate.doc: The estimation of a nearby object’s vertical position as it relates to the user’s device.

cameraAssistanceEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that combines the spatial awareness of ARKit with Nearby Interaction to improve the accuracy of a nearby object’s position.

extendedDistanceMeasurementEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether both peers can use extended distance measurement for this Nearby Interaction session instance.

peerDiscoveryToken.doc: A value that uniquely identifies the other peer in the interaction session.

configuration.doc: The configuration run by the session.

delegate.doc: An object that the framework notifies of session events.

delegateQueue.doc: The dispatch queue on which the session invokes delegate callbacks.

deviceCapabilities.doc: An object that communicates the device’s supported framework features.

discoveryToken.doc: A temporary, random identifier for a device.

supported.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the device supports basic interaction-session functionality.

worldTransform(for:).doc: Returns a world transform to integrate a nearby object in an AR experience.
